version.changelog: Full coverage pass: deeper guides, situation-named files, and per-user configuration

llm.summary: This is a TypeScript guidance skill with a small, disclosed preference-memory folder and no executable payloads or unrelated data access.

dimensions.detail: Requested local access is proportionate: a dedicated ~/Clawic/data/typescript/ path for configuration and memory, not broad filesystem indexing, credentials, browser/session stores, or unrelated project data.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is Markdown/JSON guidance only, with no executable scripts, dependency installation, remote payload retrieval, or tool-wrapping behavior found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: It tells the agent to read a scoped config and memory file on first use and to write preferences only when the user states them; that persistence is disclosed and limited to TypeScript preferences, though users should understand it may affect future TypeScript help.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill uses cross-session preference memory and suggests migrating old TypeScript skill data into the new folder, but this is narrow, disclosed in the skill metadata/content, and tied to personalization rather than hidden persistence.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill's capabilities match its stated purpose: TypeScript troubleshooting, typing guidance, tsconfig advice, migration help, runtime-boundary validation patterns, and compiler-performance guidance.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, know that the skill may keep TypeScript-related preferences and prior context in ~/Clawic/data/typescript/. This is useful for consistent advice, but review or delete those files if you do not want persistent personalization.
llm.findings: [SQP-2] expected: The finding is supported insofar as setup.md instructs reading and limited writing under ~/Clawic/data/typescript/, but the behavior is disclosed in SKILL.md, scoped to TypeScript preferences/memory, and writes are conditioned on the user declaring a preference, so it does not warrant Review by itself.
